svg.title: Acceptance of an actual reference-discipline design
svg.desc: A lock indication is only a starting observation. Qualification traces the real audio-clock path, checks programmed ratios and measures relative drift, phase noise and FIFO behaviour. Absolute accuracy requires an independent reference and no shared sample epoch is implied.
